'''Boegis Squadron''' was a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] commanded by [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]].

The squadron was used by Tarrak to [[Ambush on Hashim|disable]] three [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|modified corvettes]] called [[Hashim group|''Hashim'']]. After disabling them, a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|transport]], ''[[Dhoora]]'', boarded and captured ''[[Hashim 1]]'', which contained a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] prototype, while Boegis, along with [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] from [[Talon Squadron]], provided cover and escort.

The squadron was used again to try to [[Battle of Kiilimaar|kidnap]] the [[Unidentified TIE Defender chief scientist|chief scientist]] when the Imperials defeated the [[Rneekii]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. This time the attempt was unsuccessful, and the Y-wings, along with T-wings from [[Oro Squadron (Nami)|Oro Squadron]], were destroyed and the transport ''[[Choora]]'' was captured.
